content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"That was Mara Ibarra, known on Forge as Mara, login mara-river, account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Her suggestion appeared in HarborMesh issue 47: https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The issue-comments tool reported her 2026-04-12 comment c901 through my code body on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"She proposed a local replay queue to preserve readings during relay outages while retaining the existing scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Mara and my code body agreed to prototype it in comment c906 on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Our 2026-04-16 project account recorded an active prototype at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh, awaiting a field trial.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"A human report received through my code body on 2026-05-03 said the April 30 trial successfully replayed buffered readings through an outage.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"That report said wider rollout was paused on May 2 pending understanding of calibration drift, with no production deployment yet.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not verify later deployment; the repository's recorded entry point for checking present status is docs/STATUS.md.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
